propositions: 8 GitHub Actions must be bumped to new major versions across 12 workflow YAML files to support Node 24 runtime before GitHub deprecates Node 20 in 2026.
actions/checkout v6 introduced a breaking change moving persist-credentials to $RUNNER_TEMP that broke linked-worktree pushes in v6.0.0, which is fixed in v7.
All 12 affected workflow YAML files must remain valid YAML and no files outside .github/workflows/ should be modified.
The change must pass CI verification and land on main via Gerrit (the GitHub PR cannot merge directly due to repo ruleset).
